execution: Declarative fixtures. Results of actual runs are in docs/balance/evidence/. A fixture is not a result.

scenarios.title: The match holds exactly the roles and factions of this mode
scenarios.note: Every player starts in Room A in this setup: no rule limits how many players a room holds.
